newsitem.title: JAPAN: Suit says hospital mistook constipation for cancer.
newsitem.headline: Suit says hospital mistook constipation for cancer.

text.p: A Japanese woman has filed suit against her local government saying that a public health clinic misdiagnosed a bad case of constipation and performed major surgery for stomach cancer, court officials said on Friday.

"Not only did a portion of the plaintiff's large intestine get cut out, she was also forced to take time off from work," said the suit filed by a 51-year-old woman from Maebashi, a city 100 km (62 miles) northwest of Tokyo.

The civil suit is demanding 16 million yen ($128,000) in damages, alleging that the public medical centre performed needless surgery last July after a staff doctor said the woman required urgent surgery to remove a malignant intestinal tumour.
